links.outcome: Seizure recognition performance across sites and recording conditions with fixed prompts and thresholds
links.effect: Across two tertiary centers, home recordings, and a public dataset, accuracy was 0.795-0.947 and sensitivity 0.842-0.957 without site-specific recalibration.
links.quote: With prompts and decision thresholds fixed a priori, performance remained consistent across diverse real-world acquisition conditions without site-specific recalibration.

screen.reason: Evaluates a new multimodal vision-language model (EpiVLM) for automated seizure detection across heterogeneous clinical and home video datasets, testing cross-environment generalization without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
